items.heading: Nutrition and Dietetics Deal
items.text: Nutrition and dietetics deal with food, health and disease management. Titles include dietitian, clinical nutritionist, sports nutritionist and public health nutritionist, and rules about who can use which title differ.

items.heading: Read Ten Notices From Hospitals,
items.text: Read ten notices from hospitals, clinics, gyms, food firms and public health bodies and note the qualification asked. Check the official bodies for current registration and title rules.

items.heading: A Clear Niche Such As
items.text: A clear niche such as diabetes support, sports or women's health builds trust and referrals.
